elevate.move: Turn the diagrams into an illustration system drawn as carbon-copy ink: blue duplicate strokes offset behind every line, a scale tag per drawing, and the crack reader's tabs as precise plan/section sketches of real crack patterns, so the drawings themselves read as the expensive part of the site.

Make dig-to-strength one continuous scroll idea: each ticked line clip-wipes its layer into the section with its label arriving on a leader line, and the 28-day curve starts drawing exactly where 08 cure lands; mirror it in the calculator by redrawing and re-jointing the slab live as the size changes.
